body:
As we now have independent widgets in the documentation, it means that no `hits` widget were loaded before the `hitsPerPageSelector` that could set the `hitsPerPage` value of the helper state.

The `hitsPerPageSelector` currently silently ignore the error, and thus does not auto-select any of the passed values. If a `hitsPerPage` exists, it select the corresponding value in the dropdown or throw an error if none matches.

I suggest that we change this behavior and that if no `hitsPerPage` is previously set, we set it to the first value of the dropdown. We'll have to make sure the order in which `hits` and `hitsPerPageSelector` are started is irrelevant.

In a nutshell, here what I suggest, in pseudo-code:

```javascript
// Case 1
hitsWidget(hitsPerPage: 6);
hitsPerPageWidget(); // Select the value 6 if in the list, throw an error if no such value

// Case 2
hitsPerPageWidget(); // Select the first value of the list and set it as hitsPerPage

// Case 3
hitsPerPageWidget(); // Select first value of the list and set it as hitsPerPage
hitsWidget(hitsPerPage: 6); // Changes the hitsPerPage value. Updates the dropdown selected value if in the list, throw an error otherwise
```

WDYT?
